description: This Java class 'CopyTableWorker' extends SwingWorker and handles copying table data to the system clipboard asynchronously; it operates on a 'Table' object and interacts with Swing components and the system clipboard.

classes.name: CopyTableWorker
classes.description: A SwingWorker subclass that copies table data to the system clipboard in the background.

methods.name: CopyTableWorker
methods.description: Constructor initializing with a Table object.

methods.name: doInBackground
methods.description: Performs the operation of copying table data to clipboard in the background.

methods.name: done
methods.description: Resets cursor states after the background task completes.
